reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Trueguard again
reauth_confirm.description: The panel at {host} rejected the saved login. Enter the username and password for the panel's web interface.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Trueguard
reconfigure.description: Change the panel's address, version or login. The new details are checked against the panel before they are saved. Entities and their IDs stay the same.

dhcp_confirm.title: Trueguard panel found
dhcp_confirm.description: A Trueguard / Climax panel was found at {host}. Enter the login for its web interface and its panel version.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the panel. Check the host and port.
error.wrong_version: The panel did not answer as this panel version. Pick another version.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log.

abort.wrong_version: The panel did not answer as the configured panel version.

init.title: Trueguard options
init.description:
Polling: each poll asks the panel for its alarm state and sensor list. A shorter interval updates sensors faster but puts more load on the panel's small web server.

Report server: lets the panel push alarms, arming, and faults to Home Assistant as they happen. On the panel, under Rapport indst., pick a FREE row and set it to ip://ACCOUNT@HOME-ASSISTANT-IP:PORT/CID_SIA. Never change a row that is already in use (for example TrueConnect). Changing these settings restarts the integration.

deprecated_yaml.title: Trueguard YAML configuration is no longer used
deprecated_yaml.description: Your `trueguard:` YAML configuration was imported into the Trueguard integration, which you can now change under Settings > Devices & services. Remove the `trueguard:` block from configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant to fix this issue.

yaml_import_failed.title: Trueguard YAML configuration could not be imported
yaml_import_failed.description: Your `trueguard:` YAML configuration could not be imported ({reason}). Set up Trueguard under Settings > Devices & services > Add integration, then remove the `trueguard:` block from configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant.
